description: Licensed footprint: which legal entity of an insurance group is licensed in which country, with collected branches, EEA freedom-of-services passporting and GLEIF parents. Pass exactly one group slug (from list_groups, e.g. "allianz") for the country × entity matrix, or an insurer slug for that entity alone. A large group returns its whole matrix with a first page of entity records; entitiesPage gives the nextOffset to pass as offset. Licence rows come from the directory registers; relationship enrichment comes from GLEIF and EIOPA. Null or empty enrichment means it has not been collected, not that no relationships exist.

insurer.description: Insurer slug, when asking about one entity.

limit.description: Maximum entity rows to return. Long lists also stop early to keep the response small; the page object reports total and nextOffset. Group footprints only.

offset.description: Entity rows to skip, for paging. Group footprints only.

name: get_footprint

outputSchema.description: A JSON envelope. Successful results carry dataset, version, verified and licence plus the tool’s data; failures carry error, code and retryable.

verified.description: Date the dataset snapshot was verified.

version.description: Dataset version the result was read from.

title: Get a group’s licensed footprint by country
